notes: The itemization and the 12/11 statement agree. All rent and fees through 11/30 were already paid by the tenants, since the 7,941.00 of payments cleared every charge before the 12/09 deductions. The 11/01 rent charge is 'Rent through 11/2/2024' (160), followed by a 2,240 rent charge on 11/05 for the rest of November. This supports a 11/02 vacate date; the xlsx lists 11/30. The sheet shows lease end 2024-11-30, while the lease document runs to 9/30/2025. Ledger history starts 08/11/24 with a 2,354 September rent. The packet title 'Renewal VRTL Lead + Pets', the zero amounts due at signing and the sheet's 2022 start all indicate a renewal, but this is inferred. The monthly SD-waiver fee is 86.00 on the signed addendum and 85.00 as billed ('Preferred Tenant Program'). Two dogs are listed on the pet addendum, and the only pet-related charge is the 250 ozone line. No flooring was charged, though the inspector recommended carpet replacement. Two jpgs and the duplicate zip were not opened.
